standard: Endpoint protection console events (same columns as network_logs/audit/endpoint_protection.csv)
notes: One folder per organisation: city, nascc, brw, port, srmc, bcmc, county. Each organisation has its own products, rule names, zone names and habits; do not assume a value seen in one folder means the same in another. Hosts, addresses and accounts are in registries/partner_it_registry.json.

fields.name: event
fields.notes: DEFINITIONS_UPDATED, SCAN_STARTED, SCAN_COMPLETED, REALTIME_PROTECTION_ENABLED, REALTIME_PROTECTION_DISABLED, THREAT_QUARANTINED, AGENT_UPDATED, AGENT_HEARTBEAT_MISSED

fields.name: detail
fields.notes: version strings and detection names in the vocabulary of the organisation's endpoint product (three different products are in use)

fields.name: initiated_by
fields.notes: system, or the registry account that started it
